# Volunteers of Tanzania (VOT Mwanza)

> Volunteers of Tanzania (also known as Volunteer to Tanzania, VOT Mwanza, legal name VOT Mwanza Limited) is a registered local organisation based in Mwanza, Tanzania, hosting international volunteers, interns and students since 2018. Programs include teaching, healthcare, childcare, community, conservation and university internships, from USD 295 per week including accommodation at VOT Hostel, three meals a day and airport pickup. VOT does not charge a placement fee; the weekly price covers living costs during the stay.

- Location: SAUT Road, Igubinya Street, House No. 2, Nyegezi, Mwanza, Tanzania (P.O. Box 4127), about 8 km from Mwanza City Centre on Lake Victoria
- Email: samlugema@volunteertotanzania.com, millangah@votmwanza.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +255 765 883 202, +255 769 519 123
- Stays: 1 week to 6 months or more; 2–4 weeks recommended
- Arrival airport: Mwanza Airport (MWZ)

## Volunteer programs

- [Teaching / Education](https://www.volunteertotanzania.com/education.html): assist teachers in local primary and secondary schools in Mwanza
- [Healthcare placements](https://www.volunteertotanzania.com/healthcare.html): clinics and hospitals with local supervision
- [Community programs](https://www.volunteertotanzania.com/community.html): overview of community-based placements
- [Daycare & community children](https://www.volunteertotanzania.com/daycare-children.html)
- [BMCC Day Care](https://www.volunteertotanzania.com/bmcc-day-care.html)
- [Early childhood development (TECEC)](https://www.volunteertotanzania.com/tecec-early-childhood.html)
- [Conservation & Lake Victoria](https://www.volunteertotanzania.com/conservation-lake-victoria.html)
- [Wildlife conservation](https://www.volunteertotanzania.com/wildlife-conservation.html)
